name: Money and Power

tenures.source: PPWO Matchwatch Newsletter, Vol.1 Iss.4 (eIYX69HId2IJ); billed against The Showstoppers on the fed's own Friday Night Carnage lineup of 12 Dec 1997 (4pkWRif1DDAJ).

caption: The PPWO's Tucson Heavyweight Tag Team Champions from 8 November 1997, an undefeated 3-0-0 reign per the fed's own newsletter, though no surviving document separately names the team's own two members.

identity.note: The same billing exists in other wings; this entity was minted from its own federation's 1997 documents with no receipt joining it to those — held distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule; reopenable on a shared-handler or cross-fed receipt.
